description:
Returns the key and value of an app's property. The property key `connect_client_key_019cdff3-8bfb-71fe-9628-875b700aebb8`
is reserved. It returns a synthetic, read-only property containing the Connect `clientKey` for the requested tenant.
This is intended for Forge apps with `app.connect.key` to retrieve the Connect client key during migration.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only a Connect app whose key matches `addonKey` can make this request.
Additionally, Forge apps can access Connect app properties (stored against the same `app.connect.key`).

parameters.description: The key of the app, as defined in its descriptor.
parameters.name: addonKey

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

example.message: The property key cannot be longer than 127 characters.

400.description: Returned if the property key is longer than 127 characters.

example.message: Access to this resource must be authenticated as an app.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description: Returned if the property is not found or doesn't belong to the app.
